bootstrap-repo.use_when: Selecting, installing, or updating curated skills in a target repository or host catalog.

writing-for-agents.use_when: Writing or reviewing agent instructions, skill triggers, stage prompts, or repository guidance; removing LLM-isms, tightening prose, or plain-language drafting.

retro.use_when: Tracing session friction or failures to recommend deterministic checks, scripts, or instruction fixes when a retrospective is requested.

handoff.use_when: Writing a workspace-verified continuation brief to transfer active work to a new session or agent.

diagnosing-bugs.use_when: Investigating non-obvious bugs or performance regressions with repeatable reproductions, minimized cases, and falsifiable hypotheses.

codebase-design.use_when: Evaluating module interfaces, shallow pass-through layers, ownership boundaries, or refactorings.

tdd.use_when: Implementing features or bug fixes test-first using vertical red-green-refactor slices.

domain-modeling.use_when: Aligning ambiguous domain terminology in code and glossaries, or recording consequential architecture decision records (ADRs).

agent-workflow-engineering.use_when: Designing, implementing, or diagnosing agent application control flow, state ownership, typed tools, idempotent side effects, approvals, and crash recovery.

code-review.use_when: Reviewing a proposed code change for demonstrated defects, compatibility breaks, and material avoidable cost, including re-review outcome tracking.

python-project-setup.use_when: Initializing, repairing, or modernizing Python packaging (pyproject.toml, src/ layout), dependency groups, and development checks.

rust-project-setup.use_when: Initializing, repairing, or tightening a Rust workspace's toolchain pin, Clippy/rustfmt policy, dependency hygiene, tests, and CI checks.

rust-idioms.use_when: Writing, refactoring, or reviewing Rust where argument types, construction, error types and panics, moves out of borrows, cleanup guards, public-type extensibility, design patterns, or FFI boundaries are decided.

python-service-engineering.use_when: Implementing or diagnosing Python service resource lifetimes, asyncio concurrency, backpressure, cancellation, and boundary validation.

rag-engineering.use_when: Building or diagnosing retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, lexical/hybrid baselines, stage-by-stage loss, and evidence assembly.

rag-evaluation.use_when: Designing, running, or auditing retrieval-augmented generation evaluations, multi-set sufficiency rubrics, and controlled comparisons.

technical-document-review.use_when: Reviewing, revising, or re-verifying substantive technical documents, specifications, and reports for factual, mathematical, citation, and prose accuracy.

diff-simplification.use_when: Simplifying task-owned hunks of an implemented change when a concrete maintenance reduction preserves behavior; not for planning or read-only review.

agent-harness-audit.use_when: Auditing or designing a coding-agent harness's tool catalog, per-request context and prompt caching, long-running commands, or compaction and memory.

change-sequencing.use_when: Deciding whether and how to split a feature, refactor, or migration into reviewable, independently deployable and revertible changes.

github-pr.use_when: Writing commit messages, pull request titles, and pull request descriptions that follow repository conventions, explain the change to a human reader, and carry no tool attribution.

github-issues.use_when: Writing, sizing, and filing GitHub issues and sub-issues, and reconciling linked issues and follow-ups after a pull request merges.

tui-best-practices.use_when: Building, refactoring, or reviewing interactive terminal user interfaces (TUIs), raw-mode lifecycle, event loops, layout degradation, or headless CLI parity.

verification-harness.use_when: Setting up or strengthening a repository's deterministic verification for agent-written changes: a fast verify entrypoint, end-to-end drivers, property and differential oracles, mutation checks on tests, and flaky-test policy.

agent-harness.note: Supports maintaining an agent harness and hosts that read the locked catalog. Installation makes packages available; each host applies its own selection policy and stage rules.

engineering.note: General interactive engineering selection; map terminology and decision records to existing repository conventions.
